sources.citation: Wikipedia (en). 'Kho'ini dialect' (raw wikitext, fetched sources 2026-09-17); a digest of Yarshater 2002/2003, its only reference
sources.note: Second-hand and morphological only: abstract nouns take 'a stressed -i'; preterite of intransitives = 'past stem (the stress falling on the last syllable of it) + the present tense of to be'; past participle/progressive = past stem + 'a stressed -a'. No general word-stress rule.

sources.citation: Skjaervo, P. O. 'IRAN vi(2). Documentation', Encyclopaedia Iranica online, extracted from the 2020 Iranica siterip (archive.org item 'iranica')
sources.note: Nothing on Xo'ini stress. The siterip's index of 15,352 Iranica articles (2020) contains no Xo'ini/Kho'ini entry, so the 'Encyclopaedia Iranica article on the Xo'ini dialect' named by the earlier scan could not be confirmed to exist; iranicaonline.org itself is Cloudflare-403 and has no Wayback snapshot.
